erikvukk: Konrad Erikvukk came from Oakmere, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Konrad Erikvukk answered the first call, number 37 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
The new duty roster listed Konrad Erikvukk as a stretcher bearer. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.
Verdel Ridge has been won. Konrad Erikvukk listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Konrad Erikvukk splinted a broken leg with a rifle and two belts. The patient asked if he was a real doctor. He said yes. He was lying.
At Saint-Ash crossroads, Konrad Erikvukk of the Concord and Felix "Parson" Brendanm of the Hegemony spent the morning shooting at the same loose sheet of metal. The sheet kept winning.

Asked what he will do after the war, Konrad Erikvukk said: 'Be a farmhand in Oakmere. And never complain about anything, ever again.' The Hegemony won Hill 304. In R-F13, Konrad Erikvukk listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Rain all night. Konrad Erikvukk bailed water out of R-F13 with a helmet until his hands stopped feeling anything.
felix.kfg: The draft reached R-F20 on Day 4. Benedikt Kfg was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
Dawn watch. Benedikt Kfg put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Arno "Doc" Jameson, gravely wounded.

Benedikt Kfg was promoted to Lance Corporal. The first request addressed to the new rank concerned a blocked drain. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Benedikt Kfg wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Benedikt Kfg had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any.
idkdunnoman: The draft reached R-S9 on Day 5. Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman sorted the dressings by lamplight. When the next stretcher arrived, he could find everything without looking.
kellen_mcplate: Cyril "Hollow" Mcplate walked into R-S7 on Day 6 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
An empty jam tin became Cyril "Hollow" Mcplate's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.
lei.shi04: Marek Shi found a place in R-S5 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
mrpickypants_: The new machine gunner gave his name as Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants received the First Wave ribbon. He checked the stitching twice before putting the tunic back on.
Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants walked the captured trenches of Verdel Ridge and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
Albin Zgz and Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.

The shelling stopped while Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants was counting the seconds between hits. He kept counting anyway, and waited a long time before moving. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into S-F14. Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants has learned to walk bent double.
Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants found water collecting beneath the gun's cover. He sketched a small shelter and took the drawing to the stores.
